verdict.rationale: Kling's homepage makes a first-party claim of an MCP/CLI offering that lets a user's agent drive Kling generation, so an official MCP server appears to exist. The evidence is a single marketing line with no setup docs, tool list, endpoint, or transport details, and nothing independent confirms it. Missing for 10: MCP server documentation (installation/connection steps, exposed tools, auth flow), endpoint or package details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: MCP / CLI Let Your Agent Power Kling, Turn Ideas into Videos at Scale
